    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【EF Core】继承策略——TPT</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>先补充一下前一篇中的 TPH 策略的内容——非完整性类型鉴别器。这个东西官方文档写了等于没写，许多大伙伴可能不知道是啥玩意儿。不用慌，老周给你整个示例，你就懂了。</p>
<p>这种特例多见于先有数据库（DB First）的方案。好，那咱们就先建库，脚本如下，很简单。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">use</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> master;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 创建数据库</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">create</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">database</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> schoolDB;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">use</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> schoolDB;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 创建表</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">create</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">table</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 基类字段</span>
    id <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">identity</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> “转校生”字段</span>
    src_school <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">40</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> “留级生”字段</span>
    repeat_grade <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 鉴别器字段</span>
    _type <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 主键</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">constraint</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Student</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">primary</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">key</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">asc</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 添加点数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">insert</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">into</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tb_students
    (</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, age, src_school, repeat_grade, _type)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">values</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    (N</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">王番薯</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">19</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">S</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    (N</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">吴正经</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span>, N<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">华中聊汉大学</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">T</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    (N</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">余小琳</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">17</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">3</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">R</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    (N</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">欧皮革</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Z</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span></pre>
</div>
<p>上述脚本做了三件事：</p>
<p>1、创建数据库，命名为 schoolDB；</p>
<p>2、在库中建表，名为 tb_students；</p>
<p>3、往表中写入新数据，用于示例。</p>
<p>tb_students 表其实包含了三个实体：</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">A、正常学生（id、name、age）；</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">B、转校生，在正常学生基础上增加了 src_school 列，表示从哪个学校转过来的；</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">C、留级生，在正常学生基础上增加 repeat_grade 列，重读的年级。</span></p>
<p>用作类型鉴别器的是 _type 列，S 指代正常学生，T 指代转校生，R 指代留级生，Z 无意义。</p>
<p>好了，数据库搞好了，下面弄 EF Core。</p>
<p>先定义三个实体类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 正常学生
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Student
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Age { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转校生
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TransferStudent : Student
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> SourceSchool { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 留级生
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RepeatStudent:Student
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> RepeatGrade { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在数据库上下文的 OnModelCreating 方法中配置模型。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 映射策略和主键都要在基类上配置</span>
    modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Student&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        ent.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">UseTphMappingStrategy</span>();
        ent.HasKey(x </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x.Id);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表映射</span>
        ent.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_students</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 列映射</span>
        ent.Property(x =&gt; x.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Age).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 鉴别器</span>
        ent.HasDiscriminator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">StuType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasValue</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">&lt;Student&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">S</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>
            .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasValue</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">&lt;TransferStudent&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">T</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>
            .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasValue</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">&lt;RepeatStudent&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">R</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
        ent.Property</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">StuType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    });

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 派生类的映射</span>
    modelBuilder.Entity&lt;TransferStudent&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.SourceSchool).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">40</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">src_school</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    });
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;RepeatStudent&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        ent.Property(u </span>=&gt; u.RepeatGrade).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">repeat_grade</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    });
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>现在咱们尝试把所有数据查询出来。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置连接字符串</span>
DbContextOptionsBuilder&lt;MyContext&gt; opbuilder = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
opbuilder.UseSqlServer(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data Source=.\\TEST;Initial Catalog=schoolDB;Integrated Security=True;Persist Security Info=False;Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=True</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext(opbuilder.Options);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取数据集合</span>
<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">DbSet&lt;Student&gt; stus = context.Set&lt;Student&gt;</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">()</span></strong>;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stus)
{
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id:  {0}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, s.Id);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name: {0}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, s.Name);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">age: {0}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, s.Age);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(s <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TransferStudent tfstu)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">source school: {0}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tfstu.SourceSchool);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(s <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RepeatStudent rpstu)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">repeat grade: {0}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, rpstu.RepeatGrade);
    }
    Console.WriteLine();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这个代码在运行后，你会看到该错误：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202605/367389-20260531111207073-1232395123.png" alt="image" width="445" height="82" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>现在回过头看看鉴别器配置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ent.HasDiscriminator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">StuType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .HasValue</span>&lt;Student&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">S</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .HasValue</span>&lt;TransferStudent&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">T</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .HasValue</span>&lt;RepeatStudent&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">R</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>再看看数据库中的数据。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> _type <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> tb_students</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202605/367389-20260531111436244-1113667300.png" alt="image" width="76" height="105" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>根据咱们的配置，Student 类由 S 表示，TransferStudent 类由 T 表示，RepeatStudent 类由 R 表示。Z 是没有类型映射的，这个异常的意思就是类型的鉴别值不完整——就是多了个Z出来，EF Core 不知道 Z 跟哪个实体类有关。</p>
<p>这种情况，我们要明确告诉 EF Core，咱们这个数据库中的鉴别器的值与实际的实体类型没有完全匹配的，我们所配置的类型鉴别的值是不完整的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ent.HasDiscriminator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">StuType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .HasValue</span>&lt;Student&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">S</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .HasValue</span>&lt;TransferStudent&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">T</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .HasValue</span>&lt;RepeatStudent&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">R</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">IsComplete(</span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>)</span></strong>;</pre>
</div>
<p>true 表示类型列表是完整的，false 是不完整的。这样配置后就不会抛异常了。</p>
<p>--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>现在进入主题，今天咱们聊 TPT 策略。TPT 会为每个实体类型独立映射一个数据表，但表中的列仅限于当前类所定义的成员，不包含从基类继承的成员。</p>
<p>咱们依旧使用上面那三个【学生】实体，不过，这次配置为 TPT 映射策略。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 映射策略和主键都要在基类上配置</span>
    modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Student&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        ent.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">UseTptMappingStrategy()</span></strong>;
        ent.HasKey(x </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x.Id);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表映射</span>
        ent.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_students</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(u </span>=&gt; u.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(u </span>=&gt; u.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(u </span>=&gt; u.Age).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });

        ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Name).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    });

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 派生类的映射</span>
    modelBuilder.Entity&lt;TransferStudent&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.SourceSchool).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">40</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表映射</span>
        ent.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_trf_students</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(i </span>=&gt; i.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(i </span>=&gt; i.SourceSchool).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">src_school</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    });
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;RepeatStudent&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表映射</span>
        ent.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_rpt_students</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(w </span>=&gt; w.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(w </span>=&gt; w.RepeatGrade).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">repeat_grade</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    });
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>不管你用哪种映射策略，UseXXXMappingStrategy 方法必须在配置基类实体时调用，不能在派生类的配置中调用，那样会报错。</p>
<p>由于 TPT 是每个类型一个表，所以你可以用 ToTable 方法为各个表自定义名称。</p>
<p>这里各位要注意：列映射的自定义名称最好在 ToTable 方法中通过 TableBuilder 对象来配置，不要在实体属性上直接配置（ent.Property(...).HasColumnName(...)）。这是因为在 PropertyBuilder 上配置的列名是通过 Annotations 字典（Key = Relational:ColumnName）来存储的，这表明这个列名你能存储一个值。如果这个属性被多次列映射，那么，后面设置的列名会覆盖掉前面设置的列名，而不管你映射的是否为同一个表。</p>
<p>对 TPT 策略而言，只有主键列会被多次映射，其他属性不会有覆盖的问题（派生类的表不包含基类成员，自然就不会重复映射了）。比如，基类 Student，在 tb_students 表中映射了 Id、Name、Age 属性；到了 TransferStudent 类，它只定义了 SourceSchool 属性，所以表&nbsp; tb_trf_students 中只映射 SourceSchool 成员。RepeatStudent 实体同理。</p>
<p>从上面的配置代码看到，只有 Id 属性被做了多次列映射。所以，除了 Id 属性以外，其他属性是可以在 PropertyBuilder 上用 HasColumnName 方法配置列映射的，但为了代码更好看，统一用 TableBuilder 来配置最好。尤其在 TPC 策略下各个属性都会多次映射（本文先不提）。</p>
<p>那么，为什么 TPT 策略要把基类的主键映射多次呢？看看它生成的 SQL 语句，你或许就明白了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_tb_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_rpt_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">mid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">repeat_grade</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_tb_rpt_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">mid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">FK_tb_rpt_students_tb_students_mid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FOREIGN</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">mid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">REFERENCES</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>)</span></strong> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CASCADE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_trf_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">mid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">src_school</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">40</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_tb_trf_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">mid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">FK_tb_trf_students_tb_students_mid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FOREIGN</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">mid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">REFERENCES</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_students</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>)</span></strong> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CASCADE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span></pre>
</div>
<p>不知道大伙伴们看出啥门道了没有。在 TPT 映射策略中，只有基类的主键列会生成/插入新值，其他派生类表都是通过外键来引用基类表的主键的。正因为这样，所以在查询数据时，就等于做联表查询，这使得 TPT 策略的性能会比其他策略低。</p>
<p>&nbsp;啥意思呢，咱们试着插入几条记录就知道了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext(opbuilder.Options);

context.Database.EnsureCreated();       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 运行时创建数据库
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取数据集合</span>
DbSet&lt;Student&gt; students = context.Set&lt;Student&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加新记录</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">students.AddRange([
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Student</span>{Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">吴珍珠</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Age = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">TransferStudent</span>{Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">王大山</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Age = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span>, SourceSchool = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">飓风中学</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">RepeatStudent</span>{Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">陆大锤</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Age = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">17</span>, RepeatGrade = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
    ]);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存数据</span>
context.SaveChanges();</pre>
</div>
<p>咱们每个类型各添加一条记录，看看数据库怎么存储它们。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">*</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tb_students;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">*</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tb_trf_students;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">*</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> tb_rpt_students;</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202605/367389-20260531121534669-944670084.png" alt="image" width="119" height="193" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">【吴珍珠】同学的 Id 为2，因为它是 Student 类，作为基类，只用到 tb_students 表；</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">【王大山】同学的 Id 为 3，它是&nbsp;TransferStudent 类。从基类继承的 Name 和 Age 属性存放到 tb_students 表中，而&nbsp;SourceSchool 属性的值则存放在&nbsp;tb_trf_students 表的&nbsp;src_school 列中；</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">【陆大锤】同学的 Id 为1，它是&nbsp;RepeatStudent 类，其中 Name、Age 属性存入&nbsp;tb_students 列，而它所定义的&nbsp;RepeatGrade 属性的值就存入&nbsp;tb_rpt_students 表的 repeat_grade 列。</span></p>
<p>最后，咱们把注意力放在主键列上。所有记录的主键值都在基类表中生成（tb_students.id 列），然后</p>
<p>对于【吴珍珠】同学，它就在基类表中，不需要外键引用；</p>
<p>对于【王大山】同学，tb_trf_students.mid 列通过外键，引用了主键值 3；</p>
<p>对于【陆大锤】同学，tb_rpt_students.mid 列通过外键引用了主键值 1；</p>
<p>目前 EF Core 在配置主键的约束名称是有限制的，所以不要去自定义主键的约束。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 不要调用 HasName 方法</span>
ent.HasKey(x =&gt; x.Id).<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasName</span></strong>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_what_the_fk</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>下面老周解释一下为什么会有这个局限。</p>
<p>1、派生类中不允许配置主键。看看 EntityType.SetPrimaryKey 方法的源代码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">virtual</span> Key?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SetPrimaryKey(
    IReadOnlyList</span>&lt;Property&gt;?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> properties,
    ConfigurationSource configurationSource)
{
    EnsureMutable();
    Check.DebugAssert(IsInModel, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The entity type has been removed from the model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (BaseType != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span></span></strong>    <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> InvalidOperationException(CoreStrings.DerivedEntityTypeKey(DisplayName(), GetRootType().DisplayName()));
</span></strong></span>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">}</span></strong>

   ……
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>意思就是如果你正在配置的实体存在基类，那就抛出异常。所以，你只能在基类上配置主键。</p>
<p>2、对于 EF Core 的数据库模型，如果实体存在继承关系，那么，派生类实体所继承的成员，与基类实体所定义的同一个成员，它们之间使用相同的元数据。这后果是，如果你在 Student 类中配置了主键的约束名为 PK_XXX，那么，TransferStudent 类和 RepeatStudent 类的 Id 属性都从 Student 害继承，即它们的元数据相同，导致所有数据表的主键的约束名都变成 PK_XXX。多个表使用相同的约束名，在数据库中会报错。</p>
<p>所以，你不能改变约束名，一改就全部一起改掉了。但保留 EF Core 的默认配置就没有问题，因为 EF Core 在生成 SQL 语句时，主键默认的名字是 PK_&lt;表名&gt;，外键是 FK_&lt;表名&gt;，这样就不会出现重复约束名了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>这时候有大伙伴可能想到了使用约定来修改主键的约束名称。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyConvention : IModelFinalizingConvention
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> ProcessModelFinalizing(IConventionModelBuilder modelBuilder, IConventionContext&lt;IConventionModelBuilder&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entStudent = modelBuilder.Metadata.FindEntityType(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(Student));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(entStudent != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key = <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">entStudent.FindPrimaryKey() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> IMutableKey</span></strong>;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(key != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">key.SetName(</span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Stu_base</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>;
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entTrfStudent = modelBuilder.Metadata.FindEntityType(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(TransferStudent));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(entTrfStudent != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key = entTrfStudent.FindPrimaryKey() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IMutableKey;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(key != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                key.SetName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Transf_stu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entRptStudent = modelBuilder.Metadata.FindEntityType(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(RepeatStudent));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (entRptStudent != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key = entRptStudent.FindPrimaryKey() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IMutableKey;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (key != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                key.SetName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Rpt_stu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>数据库模型一旦 Finalized 阶段就变成只读了，无法修改元数据。所以你不能在实例化 DbContext 之后修改，那时候已经改不了。故，咱们要用约定的话，只能在 Finalizing 阶段。这时候模型的配置已经完成，但还未被固化（只读），即实现&nbsp;IModelFinalizingConvention 接口，这样做可以避免被其他约定干扰。</p>
<p>约定类写好后，重写 DbContext.ConfigureConventions 方法，将其注册到约定集合中。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigureConventions(ModelConfigurationBuilder configurationBuilder)
{
    configurationBuilder.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Conventions.Add(_ </span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> MyConvention())</span></strong>;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然而，结果会让你失望的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE [tb_students] (
    [id] </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NOT NULL IDENTITY,
    [name] nvarchar(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    [age] </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">[PK_Rpt_stu]</span> PRIMARY KEY ([id])
);
GO

CREATE TABLE [tb_rpt_students] (
    [mid] </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NOT NULL,
    [repeat_grade] </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">[PK_Rpt_stu]</span> PRIMARY KEY ([mid]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_tb_rpt_students_tb_students_mid] FOREIGN KEY ([mid]) REFERENCES [tb_students] ([id]) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
GO

CREATE TABLE [tb_trf_students] (
    [mid] </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NOT NULL,
    [src_school] nvarchar(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">40</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">[PK_Rpt_stu]</span> PRIMARY KEY ([mid]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_tb_trf_students_tb_students_mid] FOREIGN KEY ([mid]) REFERENCES [tb_students] ([id]) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
GO</span></pre>
</div>
<p>只要改其中一个，等于全部主键都改了。这时可以初步推断，由于主键是从基类继承的，所以，派生类实体的元数据中，使用的主键对象是同一个实例。</p>
<p>要证明这个推测也很容易，我们打印出三个实体的 Key 对象的内存地址。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyConvention : IModelFinalizingConvention
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">PrintObjectAddress</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> tag, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> obj)
    {
        GCHandle handle </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GCHandle.Alloc(obj, GCHandleType.WeakTrackResurrection);
        IntPtr addr </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GCHandle.ToIntPtr(handle);
        handle.Free();
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{0}: 0x{1:X}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tag, addr);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> ProcessModelFinalizing(IConventionModelBuilder modelBuilder, IConventionContext&lt;IConventionModelBuilder&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entStudent = modelBuilder.Metadata.FindEntityType(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(Student));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(entStudent != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key = entStudent.FindPrimaryKey() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IMutableKey;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(key != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                key.SetName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Stu_base</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">PrintObjectAddress(</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Student Key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">, key);</span>
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entTrfStudent = modelBuilder.Metadata.FindEntityType(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(TransferStudent));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(entTrfStudent != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key = entTrfStudent.FindPrimaryKey() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IMutableKey;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(key != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                key.SetName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Transf_stu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">PrintObjectAddress(</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TransferStudent Key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">, key);</span>
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entRptStudent = modelBuilder.Metadata.FindEntityType(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(RepeatStudent));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (entRptStudent != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key = entRptStudent.FindPrimaryKey() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IMutableKey;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (key != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                key.SetName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Rpt_stu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">PrintObjectAddress(</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">RepeatStudent Key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">, key);</span>
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后得到以下结果：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Student Key:              <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x245CD862820</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
TransferStudent Key:      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x245CD862820</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
RepeatStudent Key:        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x245CD862820</span>            </pre>
</div>
<p>看吧，它们的地址一样。</p>
<p>所以，现阶段，在 TPT 策略下你不能自定义主键的约束名称，但微软说以后的版本会支持。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
